openboard.config.mcp.enabled: Open the local MCP channel for this window so agents (via the OpenBoard MCP server) can use OpenBoard tools. Local named pipe / Unix socket only; never a network port.
openboard.language.name: OpenBoard
openboard.config.title: OpenBoard
openboard.config.defaultExportScale: Default pixel scale (1 to 4) used when exporting a board to a raster image.
openboard.config.defaultExportBackground: Default background used when exporting a board.
openboard.config.gridSpacing: Grid spacing in board units (4 to 200).
openboard.config.defaultFontFamily: Default font family for new text elements (1 to 100 characters). Leave empty to use the editor font family.
openboard.config.autoLayoutDirection: Default direction used by the auto-layout tool.
openboard.untrusted.description: In an untrusted workspace OpenBoard can view and edit boards, but tools that write other files are disabled.
openboard.virtual.description: Boards can be edited in virtual workspaces; export and file-writing tools depend on the file system provider.
